name: HR and Payroll
scope_from_master_specification: Employee profiles, recruitment/ATS, onboarding/contracts, departments/positions, attendance/biometrics, shifts, leave/overtime/timesheets, payroll, allowances/deductions/payslips/payments, configurable PAYE/NSSF/SHIF/AHL statutory rules, tax reports, appraisals, training, discipline, self-service and analytics.
required_before_production: Independent Kenyan payroll/tax professional approval of statutory rules and employee tax declarations
Secure employee bank-detail vault and bank-specific certified upload/API integration
Daraja sandbox and production callback-gateway UAT with credentials and live reconciliation
KRA iTax, SHA and NSSF return/remittance integrations and statutory payment reconciliation
Attendance-derived shift/overtime approval and roster integration
PostgreSQL concurrency/load testing, penetration testing, privacy review, backup/restore drills and customer payroll signoff
implemented_features: Employee directory, leave, attendance and effective-dated payroll profiles
Kenya versioned PAYE, NSSF, SHIF and Affordable Housing Levy rules with independent activation
Payroll allowances, taxable benefits, overtime, shifts, proration and immutable calculation snapshots
Maker-checker payroll approval, payment authorization, accounting journals and reversals
Bank CSV preparation, Safaricom Daraja B2C adapter, signed callbacks, retry and bank reconciliation
Employee payslip history, statutory workpapers, analytics and year-end reconciliation
